Show/hide driver for `#duplicator-sec` and its three sub-rows, and behavior with no/non-duplicator layer active (packet 1, 7201-7217): `var sec=document.getElementById('duplicator-sec');if(!sec)return;` (7201-7202, DOM-existence guard). `var ld=state.layers[state.activeLayerIdx];if(!ld||!ld.duplicator){sec.style.display='none';return;}` (7203-7204) — the section is HIDDEN and the function returns IMMEDIATELY whenever there is no active layer at all (`state.activeLayerIdx` out of range) OR the active layer exists but carries no `.duplicator` object (an ordinary, non-duplicator layer) — none of this scope's own fields are touched in that case, so any DOM values left over from a PREVIOUSLY active duplicator layer simply remain stale/hidden (no explicit field reset on hide). `sec.style.display='block'` (7205) only once past that guard. The three sub-rows are then driven by `isObjects=dup.sourceMode==='objects'` (7214, per the 7208-7213 comment: object mode has no single seed shape and temporal stagger doesn't apply to a pool of OTHER layers' own content): `#dup-source-sec` shown ONLY in object mode (7215); `#dup-anim-hdr-row`/`#dup-edit-source-row` shown ONLY in non-object (shape) mode (7216-7217) — mutually exclusive with `#dup-source-sec`.

The refresh-sequence divergence between this scope's own `dupRefreshFromPanel` and the IIFE's own `dupRefresh` — cited by line, both bodies read directly: `dupRefreshFromPanel` (timeline.js:7445, this scope's own packet 4) is exactly `function dupRefreshFromPanel(){loadFrame(state.currentFrame);if(window.SMEngineBridge)SMEngineBridge.renderNow();}` — TWO calls, `loadFrame` then a guarded `renderNow`. `dupRefresh` (timeline.js:11447, the wiring IIFE, out of scope) is `function dupRefresh(){loadFrame(state.currentFrame);if(window.SMMotion&&SMMotion.invalidateSymbolUnionBounds)SMMotion.invalidateSymbolUnionBounds();if(window.SMEngineBridge)SMEngineBridge.renderNow();updateDuplicatorPanel();}` — FOUR calls: the same `loadFrame`+guarded `renderNow` pair, PLUS a guarded `SMMotion.invalidateSymbolUnionBounds()` call BEFORE `renderNow`, PLUS an unconditional `updateDuplicatorPanel()` call AFTER `renderNow`.
